newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Dec 3.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Dec 3.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:
Major gold miners see gold price slide over US$4 in offshore trade.

Perth-based computer group launched its Richter Paradigm Computer in the U.S. The machine uses reduced instruction computing set (RISC) processors and is said to perform computations at much faster speed than a Pentium processor running at 166 megahertz. The company also launched the "Neurocard" which can be attached to a PC to convert it into a "reasoning" machine.
Canadian bidder Placer Dome Inc had its debt affirmed overnight by key rating agencies Moody's and Standard & Poor's following its bid for each company.

National Australia Bank Ltd is rumoured to have recently bought Advance shares as part of its preparation to block the merger of the two Sydney-based regional banks. NAB is the largest shareholder in St George and is likely to bid for the smaller bank sometime next year, according to analysts.

Shares in the transport group rise to match the offer price by Holland's KPN Nederland as fund managers rush to accept the takeover before it closes in mid-December. TNT stock continues to dominate the turnover list.
Company holds annual meeting in Sydney and may issue 1996/97 forecasts.
